notes.title: Announcing Condenser - See you at GDC!
notes.content:
Well, this is a little weird.

Hi, I'm Ryan. I made Condenser. Condenser is a small collection of tools meant to help reduce the toil and manual work that goes into researching competitive titles.

For the time being, it's in pre-pre-pre-Beta, but I'm hoping putting this out in the world will give me a little more drive to get it shipped. 


What is Condenser?

Condenser takes the manual labor from collating your research and automates it. Right now that means it can grab a lot of the key data points from any Steam store page and collate them into a CSV for easy comparison. 

It can also grab Steam reviews, both positive and negative, so you can see what your games are doing well, or where your competition is dropping the ball and you can differentiate yourself.

Why?
Fundamentally, because I wanted to. Realistically, because it was useful, and I think sharing knowledge is good for the industry. 


Future Plans
I want this to be a nice little indie-dev multitool, so I'm looking at a feature roadmap that includes things like:

Console Store Pages
Visual Identity
Wishlist and Review Reporting for your own gamedev projects.
Review Score Aggregation
Tag Assessment (The tool pulls tags already, but you do the assessment on your own!)
Making this pretty as well as easy to use.


But nothing is set in stone, so if you have a particularly strong need, GET IN TOUCH.

GDC 2025
If you're interested in talking about how you research titles, or the pain points you have when building comps, or any really toilsome process you wish a robot could do for you,  I am unreasonably interested in talking to you.  Please get in touch or find me haunting Yerba Buena Gardens during GDC.
